clue.text: Feeder shortly scoffing last of soup

indicators.note: the last of a word is its final letter, so only the end of the next word is kept
to scoff is to eat greedily, so one word swallows the other inside itself

blocks.note: shortly means before long, in a moment
the final letter of soup

explanation.surface: A baby's bottle, briefly, wolfing down the dregs of some soup.
explanation.walkthrough: SO(P)ON: P sits inside SOON.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoon is the utensil that carries food to a mouth, so it is literally something that feeds.

clue.text: Deal with media holding business up

clue.text: Where I’m mourned during burial, under no circumstances!

explanation.walkthrough: T(ANT)R + UM. 'Social worker' is a common crossword trick for an ant or a bee.

clue.text: Quality letter

taken as written

clue.text: Reveal pictures drawn by scamp?
